title: BlackRock, Inc's deemed interest in CapitaLand Ascendas REIT rises after S$431K share purchase
body: BlackRock, Inc's deemed interest in CapitaLand Ascendas REIT rose after a party linked to the holder bought 192,800 shares in a market transaction at S$2.2354 per share, for a total of S$430,985. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 349,605,574 shares (6.99%) to 349,798,374 shares (7.00%).

title: BlackRock, Inc ceases to be substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd
body: BlackRock, Inc reported a change in deemed interest in Venture Corp Ltd. The filing attributes the change to a decrease in shares held as collateral. The transaction involved 968,997 shares. No shares are held directly. Total interest falls from 14,685,927 shares (5.12%) to 13,716,930 shares (4.78%). With this, the holder ceases to be a substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd.

title: Han Seng Juan buys S$59,500 of Centurion Corp Ltd shares
body: Han Seng Juan bought 50,000 shares of Centurion Corp Ltd in a market transaction at S$1.19 per share, for a total of S$59,500. Total interest rises from 374,652,326 shares (44.56%) to 374,702,326 shares (44.57%).
deemed_interest_text: (1) Mr Han Seng Juan ("Mr Han") holds a 50% shareholding interest in Centurion Global Ltd (“Centurion Global”).       Centurion Properties Pte. Ltd. (“Centurion Properties”) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Centurion Global. Mr Han is, therefore, deemed to have an interest in 225,756,126 shares held by Centurion Properties in the       Company. (2) Mr Han is also deemed to have an interest in 7,947,500 shares held by his spouse, Kang Lee Cheng Susanna,       which are registered in the name of DB Nominees (Singapore) Pte Ltd. (3) Mr Han is the beneficial owner of 10,110,400 shares held by Sunsprings Holdings Ltd and is deemed to have an       interest in these shares, which are registered in the name of Citibank Nominees Singapore Pte Ltd.
remarks_text: (1)  Of the 130,888,300 shares held by Mr Han, 25,064,000 shares are registered in the name of Citibank Nominees        Singapore Pte Ltd, 11,283,300 shares are registered in the name of UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd, 402,300 shares are        registered in the name of Oversea-Chinese Bank Nominees Pte Ltd, 6,877,500 shares are registered in the name        of Maybank Securities Pte. Ltd., 7,978,700 shares are registered in the name of CGS International Securities        Singapore Pte Ltd, 25,000,000 shares are registered in the name of DBS Nominees (Private) Limited, 15,000,000        shares are registered in the name of United Overseas Bank Nominees (Private) Limited and 39,282,500 shares        are registered in his own name. (2) The percentage of shareholding immediately before and after the transaction is calculated based on the       Company's number of issued ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares) of 840,778,624 shares as at 18       November 2026.

title: Ravinder Sajwan buys S$68,185 of Ultragreen Ai Ltd shares
body: Ravinder Sajwan bought 142,100 shares of Ultragreen Ai Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.4798 per share, for a total of S$68,185. Total interest rises from 685,736,454 shares (62.41%) to 685,878,554 shares (62.43%).
deemed_interest_text: The business and affairs of IR Investments LP are managed by a board of managers (the “IR Board of Managers”). IR Holding Company Inc., the general partner of IR Investments LP, has on 15 December 2019 appointed Mr Sajwan as the sole and initial member of the IR Board of Managers. Mr Sajwan is also a Protector of The Saul Trust and a member of Saul Strategic Limited (which holds 100% of Saul Holdings Pte. Ltd.’s ordinary shares). Accordingly, for the purposes of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore and the Securities and Futures (Disclosure of Interests) Regulations 2012, Mr Sajwan has a deemed interest in the Shares held by Renew Group Private Limited.
remarks_text: THE PERCENTAGE IN SHAREHOLDING IS CALCULATED BASED ON THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF 1,098,647,200  SHARES, EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES, AS AT 17 NOVEMBER 2026.

title: IMC Dynamic Investments Pte. Ltd's stake in Q & M Dental Group (Singapore) Ltd falls to 6.65% from 6.77% after corporate action
body: IMC Dynamic Investments Pte. Ltd's stake in Q & M Dental Group (Singapore) Ltd moved from 6.77% to 6.65% following a corporate action by the company. The filing attributes the change to the issue and allotment of new shares to Keera Capital Ltd pursuant to the completion of the Thailand Acquisition. The number of shares held is unchanged at 64,132,538.
relationship_text: IMC Heritas Investments Ltd. ("IMCHI") is the owner of the entire issued share capital of IMC Dynamic. Tsao Pao Chee Group Limited ("TPCG") is the owner of the entire issued share capital of IMCHI. By virtue of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 ("SFA"), IMCHI and TPCG are deemed to be interested in the 64,132,538 shares in Q & M held by IMC Dynamic.
remarks_text: The change in interest arises from the issue and allotment of 16,375,714 new shares in Q & M to Keera Capital Ltd pursuant to the completion of the Thailand Acquisition, as announced by Q & M on 13 November 2026. The percentage shareholding before the change in interest is calculated based on Q & M's issued share capital of 947,620,661 ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares), as announced in Q & M's Share Buy-back Announcement dated 21 October 2026. The percentage shareholding after the change in interest is calculated based on Q & M's enlarged issued share capital of 963,996,375 ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares).
change_reason: the issue and allotment of new shares to Keera Capital Ltd pursuant to the completion of the Thailand Acquisition
